title: Bilibili transcript extract
summary: Official Bilibili captions stay login-gated via SESSDATA and player/wbi/v2. GitHub tools (bilibili-cli, BiliSum, video-captions, yt-dlp) agree; public X talk this month is about subtitle quality, not the fetch API.
synthesisHtml:
🌐 last30days v3.8.2 · synced 2026-09-19

What I learned:

Official CC is login-gated. GitHub is where this topic actually lives this month. public-clis/bilibili-cli sits at 1,043 stars and documents that most commands work as a guest, but bili video --subtitle needs auth. lycohana/BiliSum (595 stars) is the summarizer path: prefer uploaded or AI captions, then local ASR. LuShan123888/video-captions is smaller (6 stars) and says the quiet part: auto-read SESSDATA from the browser, or set BILIBILI_SESSDATA, then Whisper if the track is empty.

yt-dlp is still the default recipe. The extractor treats login as a SESSDATA cookie on api.bilibili.com and warns "Subtitles are only available when logged in." Zhihu's working command is --cookies-from-browser Chrome --list-subs first, then --skip-download --write-sub --sub-lang ai-zh. Tracks people actually name: danmaku (xml), zh-CN (uploader), ai-zh (platform ASR). daymade's bili-subs.sh comment from 2026-06 is blunt: anonymous player/wbi/v2 returns an empty list on every video tested. There is no login-free official-CC path.

Public chatter is about the text, not the scraper. @8flora86 asked, "Does anyone know exactly when they changed eng subtitles on bilibili in Link Click season 1? ... And I'm pretty sure they never used the word "love" in this scene." @HinaImpact: "Ever since I'm already making subtitles for the Bilibili uploads, I decided to upload both the English and Chinese subtitles to YouTube as well!" @2u619pwsachiko just said "beware of poor subtitles tho." Fan quality and dual-platform uploads beat API talk on X. Reddit's r/Bilibili hits this month were merch and a WhatsApp community, not extract how-tos.

Whisper is the common fallback, not the first step. video-captions and BiliSum (and uraraneko/bili-transcript) download audio and ASR when CC is missing. yt-dlp and bili-subs.sh do not. They write an existing track or stop. That matches a cookie-less extract: no SESSDATA means no transcript file, and the conservative tools refuse to invent one.

KEY PATTERNS from the research:

  1. SESSDATA or browser cookies - every serious tool (yt-dlp, bilibili-cli, video-captions, bili-mcp) treats official CC as login-gated via player/wbi/v2
  2. Prefer ai-zh / zh-CN, skip danmaku - list-subs first; danmaku is chat XML, not a transcript
  3. Whisper only after empty CC - BiliSum and video-captions advertise ASR fallback; yt-dlp does not
  4. X talks quality, GitHub talks fetch - fan-sub edits and YouTube dual-uploads, not API threads
  5. Agent wrappers are appearing - video-captions MCP, haotongliu58-sudo/bilibili-mcp, and bili-transcript skills all wrap the same cookie rule

I'm now an expert on Bilibili transcript extract. Some things I can help with:

  • Drop a Firefox SESSDATA into .env and retry BV1uaeA6mEDv on the youtube-app path
  • Compare yt-dlp --write-subs vs video-captions Whisper fallback when a BV has no CC
  • Wire bili video --subtitle the way bilibili-cli documents it, instead of a raw wbi call

I have all the links to the 6 Reddit threads, 25 X posts, 8 YouTube videos, 1 HN story, and 4 GitHub items I pulled from. Just ask.
